sentences.text: This is first application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail in relation to FIR No.266/2023 registered at Police Station Chaurai, District Chhindwara (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(N), 366 and 34 of Indian Penal Code.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that prosecutrix is major.
Applicant and prosecutrix were married to each other voluntarily and their marriage has also been registered by Registrar of Marriage, Municipal Corporation, Bhopal under Special Marriage Act, 1954.

entities.text: Registrar of Marriage, Municipal Corporation, Bhopal
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is submitted that later on under pressure of relative she has registered a false complaint regarding reape.
In these circumstances, applicant be enlarged on bail.
3. Learned Deputy Government Advocate appearing for State opposed the prayer for grant of bail.

It is submitted by him that though marriage may have taken place but prosecutrix has given statement Tukaram vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29295941/
1

entities.text: Tukaram vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: that she was forced to do marriage and she does not want to continue to live with applicant.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5.
Applicant has filed marriage certificate which has been issued by Registrar of Marriage, Municipal Corporation, Bhopal dated 08.02.2023.
There is possibility that prosecutrix now may not want to live along with applicant.
6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) along with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned.

8. The applicant shall abide by the conditions of Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
C.C. as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE sp/-
